brief.t: FIRST — TERRA LOTUS CONTRACT SENT (Aug 5, WhatsApp). $78,580 / 19,000 units. The clock is now on the customer: countersignature + $39,290 deposit (50%) not yet received. Next task = confirm receipt and chase the countersignature and deposit. Nothing ships and no revenue books until that deposit lands.

SECOND — ATLAS ETERNAL CONTRACT SENT (Aug 5, WhatsApp, Ryne Bell, ref PI-2026-0802). $26,500 / 5,000 units at $5.30. Open: countersignature + $13,250 deposit, and the pro forma still carried three placeholders — fill size/packaging, billing address, lead time/Incoterms. Confirm which version Ryne actually received; if placeholders went out, reissue a clean copy.

THIRD — $105,080 combined is now sitting in customer hands awaiting signature and deposits totaling $52,540. That is 70% of the monthly $150K target, and every day of silence is the risk. Set a follow-up on both for tomorrow if no reply.

THIRD — Vladimir Elgort's Stellaqua call was rescheduled overnight to today, Wednesday August 5, 12:00 PM ET, after yesterday's slot fell through on phone tag. Call his cell at 201-956-2443 if the Meet doesn't connect, and walk EDDS-versus-EDTA costed pricing, biodegradability data, and a mid-September launch timeline. Note: OpenSend's setup reminder also fires at noon today — take the Stellaqua call first.

FOURTH — Victor Armendarez's 4,000-unit two-SKU quote remains blocked on R&D's packaging-compatibility confirmation and full costs, with no update since Victor was asked to check on July 20 — now over two weeks overdue. Chase R&D directly today.

FIFTH — OpenSend's outbound-engine reminder fires today at 12:00 PM ET: Sam must greenlight 3 lookalike domains, a sending platform, create the PLL Outbound Agent, supply a booking calendar URL, and sign off the ICP Tier A definition before the 2-3 week warmup clock can start.

SIXTH — ELOIRE's Diana appears satisfied: Sam sent the full $8.20 per-unit breakdown August 4 and Diana confirmed she's waiting 30 days to see market results before reordering. No action needed today unless she reaches back out.

SEVENTH — Reply this week to accountant Austen Malczewski's still-unanswered July financial questions: a $49,745.95 Huntington withdrawal, two smaller withdrawals ($4,000 and $1,000), and a $3,788.92 ISO Group charge.

kb.a: Terra Lotus's $78,580 manufacturing contract and pro forma (19,000 units, $39,290 deposit on signing, $39,290 on completion) is complete and now includes new Articles 8-12 on insurance, indemnification and hold harmless, regulatory responsibility, limitation of liability, and survival. It has been unsent since August 2 waiting only on Sam's review and approval to send today.

Atlas Eternal (renamed by Ryne Bell) has a pro forma PI-2026-0802 for 5,000 units at $5.30, totaling $26,500, 50/50 deposit and completion terms. It's still blocked on three placeholders (fill size/packaging, billing address, lead time/Incoterms) and on whether Aiden Kraim's Adobe document names a specific additional insured or coverage limit. Yesterday's 2 PM production meeting with Ryne Bell has no confirmed outcome in the inbox yet — verify before finalizing.

Vladimir Elgort's Stellaqua call was rescheduled overnight to today, Wednesday August 5, 12:00 PM ET, after yesterday's original slot fell through on repeated phone tag. Call his cell at 201-956-2443 if the Google Meet doesn't connect. He wants per-SKU pricing at 250-400/500/1,000 units for a 3-SKU haircare line, EDDS-vs-EDTA costed comparison, OECD 301 biodegradability data, and a timeline mapped back from a mid-September launch.

ELOIRE's Diana appears satisfied. Sam sent the full $8.20 per-unit breakdown (bottle, formula, filling, printing, labels, shrink band) on August 4. Diana confirmed it was helpful and said she's waiting 30 days to see market results before deciding on the reorder; Sam agreed to hold pricing. No action needed today unless she reaches back out.

Victor Armendarez's 4,000-unit two-SKU quote (2,000 Curl Defining Cream, 2,000 Edge Gel) remains blocked. Edge Gel is a confirmed hot pour at roughly $2.90/unit target, but full costing and R&D's written packaging-compatibility confirmation are still outstanding. No confirmation has come back since Victor was asked to check with R&D on July 20 — now over two weeks overdue; chase R&D directly.

OpenSend's outbound-engine setup reminder fires today at 12:00 PM ET. Sam needs to greenlight 3 lookalike domains (about $45/year) plus a sending platform (about $40/month), create the PLL Outbound Agent, supply a booking calendar URL, and sign off the ICP Tier A definition. The 2-3 week domain/inbox warmup clock cannot start until these are approved. Opensend delivered its first CSV of 11 collected emails overnight.

Rehman Ghani's UAE tallow balm opportunity (via MOAR Global) is progressing after last week's discovery call. MOAR's team asked Sam to add three contacts (Rehman Ghani, Haifa Khawar, Ahlam Kashif) to a WhatsApp coordination group for next steps. Low effort — handle when convenient.

Jarrod Adams/Shay Brands' Tuesday August 3 2 PM ET call still has no confirmed outcome in the inbox — Sam's last message said he'd joined the Meet and didn't see Jarrod yet, with no further thread activity since. Confirm whether it connected and what tier pricing was discussed.
Alex of Shopokami has a newly confirmed discovery call for Thursday, August 6, 2:00 PM ET, to discuss his body butter private-label project. Not on today's schedule.

Private Label Labs' July 2026 Gusto invoice shows as paid automatically (confirmed August 3, 8:39 PM). No inbox evidence this run confirms the specific August 3 Huntington ACH debits ($10,233.75 and $3,952.15) were reconciled line-by-line against the pay period ledger — verify with Finance.

PLL's accountant Austen Malczewski's July financial questions from August 3 remain unanswered as of this morning: a $49,745.95 Huntington withdrawal (July 2), two smaller withdrawals ($4,000 and $1,000, July 24), and a $3,788.92 Business Gold Card charge to ISO Group. Aidan and Sam should reply this week.

Live CRM login was attempted again this morning and blocked at the credential screen — the dedicated PLL Consultant CRM account is still pending manager approval with no password on file. Today's pipeline figures are carried forward from the last verified sources: the August 1 live CRM dashboard and Sam's own end-of-day pipeline emails. Treat CRM dashboard figures as dated, not confirmed today.

Ads intelligence and Ads Agent brief are carried forward unchanged from this morning's 6:30 AM verified nightly refresh. Combined configured budget usage is at 86.6% of the approved $30/day cap — no breach. Two items await Sam's yes/no: switching ContractMfg off Maximize Conversions to Manual CPC, and confirming or reversing the unexplained Samples daily-budget cut from $10.33 to $5.00. No Ads settings were touched during this business refresh.

PLL operates at 24600 N. Industrial Dr., Farmington Hills, MI 48335. DTE service is active. UPS, USPS, and Shopify address changes and a test workflow remain pending — no new evidence this run that those were completed.
Command Center v14 is deployed and live. Sam still owes a laptop/TV validation pass of the voice picker and at least one live dispatch to confirm it behaves as expected in real use.

Separately from the Atlas Eternal deal, a Kenna Whitnell Consulting thread with Silverson (mixer equipment) is awaiting PLL's billing address for their accounting team; Kenna's office is out until August 7. The Atlas/Kenna referral-agreement countersignature remains open with no new evidence this run.
